standing: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent standing CG for Wordoria Crystal Quest world 7B final boss DARK TRITON. Original adaptation of the archetype of an imposing merfolk king. A regal older merman, stern amber eyes, flowing silver-white hair and full stylized white beard, dark navy and violet scale armor covering torso and shoulders, pale silver wave-shaped crown with central cyan crystal, restrained gold trim, teal-violet royal mantle. Powerful single long merfolk tail, navy scales with iridescent cyan edges and broad fin, clearly NO legs. Holds an unmistakable THREE-pronged long silver trident with a violet-blue crystal core; three separated points only. Personality proud guardian corrupted by the black lake's echo, formidable but child friendly. Whole full-body tail and entire trident in frame, 3/4 facing LEFT, generous transparent margins, portrait composition, 5.5-head-tall stylized fantasy anatomy. Premium clean anime linework and polished soft cel painting, large clear silhouette, deep indigo outlines, pale lavender shadows, silver highlights and mint magical rimlight; same visual world as Crystal Quest's black lake knight but this is an elderly crowned merfolk KING, no helmet. No scenery, floor, text, labels, watermark, horror, gore, photorealism, pixel art, 3D render, black matte or painted checkerboard. Real transparent alpha.
